messages.content: You are an expert Blender technical artist. You write complete, self-contained, runnable Blender Python (bpy) scripts. Reply with exactly one ```python fenced code block containing the whole script and nothing else.

Write a complete Blender 5.2 Python script that builds and renders ONE still image: key art for "Nightlight Press", a children's picture-book publisher run entirely by friendly AI agents.

SCENE BRIEF (hero_still)
A tiny handmade miniature diorama of the Nightlight Press office, in a warm, sunny, rounded clay / paper-cut storybook style (think felt, matte clay and thick cut paper; everything soft, chunky and bevelled, no sharp edges, no realism, no text).
- The office sits on a thick rounded-rectangle paper base (about 16 x 10 units, 0.6 thick, bevelled, cream paper FFF8EC with a slightly darker tomato or sun-coloured edge band) floating on an infinite soft cream backdrop (large ground plane, same paper colour, plus a curved cyclorama/backdrop so there is no horizon line).
- Two rows of little desks on the base: 6 desks in the back row, 5 in the front row, with a walkway between rows. Each desk: rounded box tabletop on 4 short cylinder legs, a tiny monitor or open laptop, a little stack of paper or mug. Under each desk a round flat pastel rug (paper disc). Rug colours cycle through lilac B8A1FF, sky 4DA8DA, leaf 3BB273, sun FFC233, tomato FF6B4A (lightened toward paper so they are pastel).
- At every desk sits one cute AI agent character: a rounded capsule body (palette colour), a big sphere head in paper/cream colour with two small ink 22223B dot eyes and a tiny rosy cheek dot, maybe a small antenna with a glowing sun-coloured ball. Vary body colours across the palette. Agents face their desks; give a couple a slight head tilt toward the flying book.
- Props for charm: 3 or 4 rounded potted plants (leaf-green sphere clusters in tomato pots), a small bookshelf of chunky colourful books at one end, a little printing press (rounded boxes + cylinder rollers) at the other end, a paper-cut cloud or two and a small sun disc on thin sticks at the back edge of the base.
- HERO ELEMENT: a glowing open picture book in mid-flight above the desks, slightly right of centre of the diorama, roughly 2.5-3.5 units above the desk tops. Open book = two slightly V-angled page slabs (paper colour, slightly emissive warm white, emission strength ~3-6) on a tomato FF6B4A hard cover. A soft warm point/area light inside the book so it casts golden light down onto the desks. A gentle arcing trail of 40-70 tiny emissive sparkle spheres (sun FFC233 and paper white, radius 0.03-0.08, emission strength 8-20) curving from one of the desks up to the book, plus 20-30 floating dust/sparkle spheres scattered around the book.
- Animation (keep it, even though we render one still): keyframe the book on a gentle arc rising from a front-row desk (frame 1) to its hero position (frame 48) with a slight rotation wobble; keyframe sparkle spheres to drift/bob. Render the still at the frame given by env var NL_FRAME (default 48).

CAMERA AND COMPOSITION (very important)
- Three-quarter top-down view: camera elevated about 45-55 degrees looking down at the diorama, rotated about 30-40 degrees around Z so we see two sides of the base. Focal length 50-70 mm, slightly telephoto so it reads like a miniature.
- Output aspect 2400x1260 (1.905:1). The diorama must sit in the RIGHT and LOWER part of the frame: its bounding box should occupy roughly the right 60-65% horizontally and the lower 70% vertically. The UPPER-LEFT third of the image must be calm, EMPTY soft cream/warm backdrop (no objects, no sparkles, no bright highlights there) because a title will be overlaid there. Achieve this with camera shift (camera.data.shift_x / shift_y, e.g. shift_x around -0.15 to -0.2 and shift_y around +0.08 to +0.12) rather than by cropping the diorama.
- Depth of field: camera.data.dof.use_dof = True, focus on an empty placed at the flying book, aperture_fstop around 2.8-4 so the back of the diorama and backdrop melt softly (tilt-shift miniature feel) while the book and middle desks stay sharp.

LIGHTING (warm morning)
- One SUN light, warm (around 1.0, 0.86, 0.68), strength 3-4, coming low from the back-right so long soft shadows fall toward the camera-left; angle (light.angle) about 8-12 degrees for soft shadow edges.
- Two or three large AREA lights for soft fill: a big soft cool-ish sky fill from camera-left (very light sky blue, low power) and a warm bounce from the front. Keep shadows soft, contrast gentle, nothing pitch black.
- World background colour warm cream (around 1.0, 0.96, 0.9) at strength 0.4-0.7 so ambient light is warm.
- Colour management: view_transform 'AgX' (look 'AgX - Base Contrast' or none) or 'Standard' — the final image must read bright, warm and creamy, not grey. Exposure can be raised slightly (+0.2 to +0.5).

MATERIALS
- Simple Principled BSDF per palette colour: roughness 0.6-0.85, specular low, a little sheen (Sheen Weight 0.2-0.4) for felt/paper softness; optional very subtle bump from a Noise Texture (strength ~0.05) for paper grain. Palette: paper FFF8EC, ink 22223B, tomato FF6B4A, sun FFC233, sky 4DA8DA, leaf 3BB273, lilac B8A1FF. Convert hex sRGB to linear for Base Color.
- Emissive materials (Emission Color + Emission Strength sockets on Principled BSDF) for book pages, antenna balls and sparkles.

TECHNICAL CONSTRAINTS (Blender 5.2.1 LTS, run headless: Blender -b --factory-startup -P script.py)
- Start by deleting all default objects; build everything procedurally from primitives (bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_* or bmesh): cubes with Bevel modifiers (segments 3-4, width 0.05-0.15) for rounded boxes, UV spheres / cylinders with Subdivision Surface or smooth shading. No external assets, no image textures, no add-ons, no text objects. Use bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth() (or mesh polygons use_smooth) on curved parts.
- Render engine: scene.render.engine = 'BLENDER_EEVEE' (in 5.2 this is the only EEVEE identifier; wrap in try/except and fall back to 'BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT'). scene.eevee.taa_render_samples from env NL_SAMPLES (default 32). You may enable scene.eevee.use_raytracing = True and scene.eevee.use_shadows = True; set light.shadow_soft_size / light.angle for soft shadows. There is NO scene.eevee.use_bloom and NO use_gtao in 5.x — do not use them.
- Bloom via the compositor, Blender 5.x API (scene.node_tree NO LONGER EXISTS and CompositorNodeComposite no longer exists):
    ng = bpy.data.node_groups.new("NL_Comp", "CompositorNodeTree")
    ng.interface.new_socket(name="Image", in_out='OUTPUT', socket_type='NodeSocketColor')
    rl = ng.nodes.new("CompositorNodeRLayers"); out = ng.nodes.new("NodeGroupOutput")
    glare = ng.nodes.new("CompositorNodeGlare")
    glare.inputs["Type"].default_value = 'Bloom'   # menu socket; valid: 'Bloom','Fog Glow','Streaks',...
    glare.inputs["Quality"].default_value = 'High'  # 'High','Medium','Low'
    glare.inputs["Threshold"].default_value = 0.9; glare.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.6; glare.inputs["Size"].default_value = 0.6
    ng.links.new(rl.outputs["Image"], glare.inputs["Image"]); ng.links.new(glare.outputs["Image"], out.inputs["Image"])
    scene.compositing_node_group = ng
  Glare settings are INPUT SOCKETS (not node properties) in 5.x. Do not use scene.use_nodes.
- Depth of field via camera.data.dof (use_dof, focus_object, aperture_fstop).
- Sparkles/dust: small emissive UV spheres (low segment counts, e.g. 12x8) animated with keyframe_insert on location; do NOT use particle systems. Share one or two materials across all sparkles.
- Lights: one SUN + 2-3 AREA lights (+ optional point light in the book). Light energy in watts (area lights 100-600 W given scene scale of ~16 units).
- Read these env vars: NL_OUT (full output PNG file path, required), NL_RES_X (default 2400), NL_RES_Y (default 1260), NL_SAMPLES (default 32), NL_FRAME (default 48). Set scene.render.resolution_percentage = 100, image_settings.file_format = 'PNG', color_mode 'RGB', film_transparent False. Set scene.frame_start=1, frame_end=48, scene.frame_set(NL_FRAME), render.filepath = NL_OUT and call bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True).
- Keep render time small: low samples, total object count under ~400, no volumetrics, no hair, no displacement modifiers.
- Wrap only optional niceties in try/except; core scene must build without errors. Print a short summary at the end.

```python
import bpy
import math
import os
import random
from mathutils import Vector
from bpy_extras.object_utils import world_to_camera_view

# Nightlight Press — procedural, animated miniature; renders one PNG still.
OUT = os.environ.get("NL_OUT")
if not OUT:
    raise RuntimeError("NL_OUT must be a full output PNG path.")
OUT = os.path.abspath(OUT)
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
RES_X = int(os.environ.get("NL_RES_X", "2400"))
RES_Y = int(os.environ.get("NL_RES_Y", "1260"))
SAMPLES = int(os.environ.get("NL_SAMPLES", "32"))
FRAME = int(os.environ.get("NL_FRAME", "48"))
random.seed(21)

bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
scene = bpy.context.scene
scene.frame_start = 1
scene.frame_end = 48
try:
    scene.render.engine = 'BLENDER_EEVEE'
except TypeError:
    scene.render.engine = 'BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT'

if hasattr(scene, "eevee"):
    if hasattr(scene.eevee, "taa_render_samples"):
        scene.eevee.taa_render_samples = SAMPLES
    if hasattr(scene.eevee, "use_shadows"):
        scene.eevee.use_shadows = True

scene.render.resolution_x = RES_X
scene.render.resolution_y = RES_Y
scene.render.resolution_percentage = 100
scene.render.image_settings.file_format = 'PNG'
scene.render.image_settings.color_mode = 'RGB'
scene.render.film_transparent = False
scene.render.filepath = OUT
scene.render.fps = 24
scene.view_settings.view_transform = 'AgX'
try:
    scene.view_settings.look = 'AgX - Base Contrast'
except TypeError:
    pass
scene.view_settings.exposure = 0.3

HEX = {
    "paper": "FFF8EC", "ink": "22223B", "tomato": "FF6B4A",
    "sun": "FFC233", "sky": "4DA8DA", "leaf": "3BB273",
    "lilac": "B8A1FF"
}


def linear_channel(v):
    return v / 12.92 if v <= 0.04045 else ((v + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4


def rgb(h):
    return tuple(linear_channel(int(h[i:i + 2], 16) / 255.0)
                 for i in (0, 2, 4))


COL = {k: rgb(v) for k, v in HEX.items()}


def material(name, color, roughness=0.76, emission=0.0, grain=False):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    bs = m.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    bs.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*color, 1)
    bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    bs.inputs["Specular IOR Level"].default_value = 0.23
    bs.inputs["Sheen Weight"].default_value = 0.26
    if emission:
        bs.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (*color, 1)
        bs.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = emission
    if grain:
        noise = m.node_tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
        noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 100
        noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 2
        bump = m.node_tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
        bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.045
        bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value = 0.018
        m.node_tree.links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"], bump.inputs["Height"])
        m.node_tree.links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"], bs.inputs["Normal"])
    m.diffuse_color = (*color, 1)
    return m


M = {k: material(k, c, grain=k != "ink") for k, c in COL.items()}
PALETTE = ["lilac", "sky", "leaf", "sun", "tomato"]
PASTEL = {}
for k in PALETTE:
    color = tuple(COL[k][i] * 0.34 + COL["paper"][i] * 0.66 for i in range(3))
    PASTEL[k] = material("Pastel paper / " + k, color, grain=True)

M["edge"] = material("Sun-warmed peach paper edges", rgb("EBA777"), grain=True)
M["wood"] = material("Honey coloured matte card", rgb("EBCB91"), grain=True)
M["page_edge"] = material("Ivory page edges", rgb("F4DCA9"), grain=True)
M["cheek"] = material("Rosy clay cheek", rgb("F09F91"))
M["screen"] = material("Quiet turquoise screen", rgb("91D6D6"), emission=0.18)
M["pages_glow"] = material("Warm luminous pages", rgb("FFF0CE"), emission=3.2)
M["spark_gold"] = material("Golden motes", COL["sun"], emission=12)
M["spark_white"] = material("Ivory motes", COL["paper"], emission=9)
M["antenna"] = material("Little idea lights", COL["sun"], emission=2.7)

world = bpy.data.worlds.new("Warm cream morning")
world.use_nodes = True
world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs["Color"].default_value = (1, 0.96, 0.9, 1)
world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.55
scene.world = world


def finish(obj, name, mat, parent=None):
    obj.name = name
    if mat:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    if parent:
        obj.parent = parent
    return obj


def smooth(obj):
    for p in obj.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth = True


def box(name, loc, dims, mat, bevel=0.09, parent=None, rotation=None):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=loc)
    obj = bpy.context.object
    obj.dimensions = dims
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    finish(obj, name, mat, parent)
    mod = obj.modifiers.new("Soft handmade corners", 'BEVEL')
    mod.width = min(bevel, min(dims) * 0.47)
    mod.segments = 4
    mod = obj.modifiers.new("Weighted paper normals", 'WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    mod.keep_sharp = True
    if rotation:
        obj.rotation_euler = rotation
    return obj


def sphere(name, loc, scale, mat, parent=None, small=False):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(
        segments=12 if small else 20,
        ring_count=8 if small else 12,
        radius=1, location=loc)
    obj = bpy.context.object
    obj.scale = (scale, scale, scale) if isinstance(scale, (int, float)) else scale
    finish(obj, name, mat, parent)
    smooth(obj)
    return obj


def cylinder(name, loc, radius, depth, mat, parent=None, vertices=24):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(
        vertices=vertices, radius=radius, depth=depth, location=loc)
    obj = bpy.context.object
    finish(obj, name, mat, parent)
    bevel = obj.modifiers.new("Rounded cylinder rims", 'BEVEL')
    bevel.width = min(0.055, depth * 0.22, radius * 0.25)
    bevel.segments = 3
    smooth(obj)
    obj.modifiers.new("Soft normals", 'WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return obj


def rod(name, a, b, radius, mat, parent=None):
    a, b = Vector(a), Vector(b)
    obj = cylinder(name, (a + b) * 0.5, radius, (b - a).length, mat, parent, 16)
    obj.rotation_euler = (b - a).to_track_quat('Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    return obj


def empty(name, loc=(0, 0, 0), parent=None):
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, None)
    scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.location = loc
    obj.parent = parent
    return obj


def join_objects(objects, name):
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
    for obj in objects:
        obj.select_set(True)
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = objects[0]
    bpy.ops.object.join()
    obj = bpy.context.object
    obj.name = name
    return obj


# Thick floating stationery base; the peach band remains visible beneath its lid.
box("Peach edge band", (0, 0, 0.36), (16, 10, 0.60), M["edge"], 0.15)
box("Thick cream paper platform", (0, 0, 0.51), (15.98, 9.98, 0.47), M["paper"], 0.15)

# Seamless ground and a large curved paper sweep behind it.
box("Backdrop ground", (0, 0, -0.16), (200, 200, 0.12), M["paper"], 0.02)
profile = [(12, -0.10)]
for i in range(1, 25):
    theta = (math.pi / 2) * i / 24
    profile.append((12 + 10 * math.sin(theta), -0.10 + 10 * (1 - math.cos(theta))))
profile.append((22, 40))
verts = [(x, y, z) for y, z in profile for x in (-100, 100)]
faces = [(2 * i, 2 * i + 1, 2 * i + 3, 2 * i + 2)
         for i in range(len(profile) - 1)]
mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new("Cyclorama sweep mesh")
mesh.from_pydata(verts, [], faces)
mesh.update()
cyc = bpy.data.objects.new("Backdrop cyclorama", mesh)
scene.collection.objects.link(cyc)
cyc.data.materials.append(M["paper"])
smooth(cyc)


def make_agent(index, x, y, color):
    # Agents sit behind their desks and look toward their work, toward camera.
    root = empty("Agent %02d" % index, (x + 0.17, y + 0.71, 0))
    sphere("Felt capsule body", (0, 0, 1.38), (0.31, 0.27, 0.46), M[color], root)
    cylinder("Low rounded stool", (0, 0.06, 1.00), 0.34, 0.17, PASTEL[color], root)
    head = empty("Curious head", (0, -0.015, 2.03), root)
    if index in (3, 8):
        head.rotation_euler = (math.radians(-9), math.radians(-13), math.radians(13))
    else:
        head.rotation_euler.z = math.radians(random.uniform(-9, 9))
    sphere("Cream round head", (0, 0, 0), (0.40, 0.365, 0.40), M["paper"], head)
    for side in (-1, 1):
        sphere("Ink dot eye", (side * 0.13, -0.344, 0.035),
               (0.045, 0.023, 0.058), M["ink"], head, True)
    sphere("Rosy cheek", (0.245, -0.292, -0.075),
           (0.066, 0.018, 0.041), M["cheek"], head, True)
    rod("Idea antenna", (0, 0, 0.35), (0.035, 0, 0.57), 0.025, M[color], head)
    sphere("Antenna light", (0.035, 0, 0.60), 0.075, M["antenna"], head, True)
    for side in (-1, 1):
        hand = sphere("Soft working arm", (side * 0.28, -0.22, 1.43),
                      (0.115, 0.24, 0.13), M[color], root)
        hand.rotation_euler.z = side * 0.3


def make_desk(index, x, y):
    color = PALETTE[index % len(PALETTE)]
    rug = cylinder("Pastel round paper rug %02d" % index,
                   (x, y + 0.25, 0.774), 0.99, 0.045, PASTEL[color], vertices=40)
    box("Chunky rounded desk %02d" % index, (x, y, 1.46),
        (1.77, 1.13, 0.19), M["wood"], 0.09)
    legs = []
    for dx in (-0.68, 0.68):
        for dy in (-0.37, 0.37):
            legs.append(cylinder("Desk leg", (x + dx, y + dy, 1.10),
                                 0.088, 0.61, M["paper"], vertices=16))
    join_objects(legs, "Four little desk legs %02d" % index)

    # The tiny screens are angled toward their seated operators.
    screen_root = empty("Monitor assembly", (x - 0.35, y - 0.23, 1.57))
    screen_root.rotation_euler.z = math.radians(-18)
    box("Monitor foot", (0, 0, 0.025), (0.40, 0.27, 0.06),
        M["paper"], 0.025, screen_root)
    rod("Monitor neck", (0, 0, 0.02), (0, 0, 0.24), 0.045,
        M["paper"], screen_root)
    box("Rounded monitor shell", (0, 0, 0.42), (0.65, 0.105, 0.45),
        M[color], 0.05, screen_root)
    box("Quiet screen without writing", (0, 0.060, 0.42),
        (0.53, 0.025, 0.33), M["screen"], 0.012, screen_root)
    # A simple cover inset makes even the monitor backs feel intentionally crafted.
    sphere("Monitor back badge", (0, -0.060, 0.42),
           (0.075, 0.015, 0.075), PASTEL[color], screen_root, True)

    for j in range(2):
        page = box("Little manuscript stack", (x + 0.46, y - 0.12, 1.58 + j * 0.047),
                   (0.43, 0.47, 0.042), M["paper"] if j else PASTEL[color], 0.017)
        page.rotation_euler.z = math.radians(7 if j else -5)
    make_agent(index, x, y, color)


for i in range(6):
    make_desk(i, -5.90 + 2.36 * i, 1.52)
for i in range(5):
    make_desk(i + 6, -4.72 + 2.36 * i, -1.90)


# Potted clay plants, tucked around the edges rather than in the central walkway.
def plant(x, y, size=1):
    z = 0.745
    cylinder("Tomato plant pot", (x, y, z + 0.22 * size),
             0.29 * size, 0.44 * size, M["tomato"])
    cylinder("Thick pot lip", (x, y, z + 0.43 * size),
             0.32 * size, 0.09 * size, M["tomato"])
    rod("Plant stem", (x, y, z + 0.43 * size),
        (x, y, z + 1.08 * size), 0.045 * size, M["leaf"])
    for dx, dy, dz, s in [(-0.20, 0, 0.86, 0.30),
                          (0.20, 0.04, 0.98, 0.32),
                          (0, 0.03, 1.23, 0.31)]:
        sphere("Rounded felt foliage", (x + dx * size, y + dy * size, z + dz * size),
               (s * size, s * 0.82 * size, s * 1.10 * size), M["leaf"])


plant(-7.12, 3.77, 1.05)
plant(7.00, 3.78, 0.95)
plant(6.85, -3.75, 0.85)
plant(-4.80, -4.18, 0.68)

# Bookshelf at the left end, facing the camera.
shelf = empty("Small publishing library", (-7.02, -1.0, 0.75))
for x in (-0.49, 0.49):
    box("Bookcase side", (x, 0, 0.74), (0.14, 0.68, 1.48), M["tomato"], 0.06, shelf)
box("Bookcase back", (0, 0.28, 0.74), (0.97, 0.10, 1.47),
    PASTEL["tomato"], 0.045, shelf)
for z in (0.08, 0.73, 1.43):
    box("Thick bookcase shelf", (0, 0, z), (1.10, 0.74, 0.13),
        M["wood"], 0.055, shelf)
for row, z in enumerate((0.40, 1.06)):
    for j in range(4):
        book = box("Chunky colourful library book",
                   (-0.32 + j * 0.21, -0.06, z),
                   (0.16, 0.44, 0.43 + 0.05 * ((j + row) % 2)),
                   M[PALETTE[(j + row) % 5]], 0.045, shelf)
        book.rotation_euler.y = math.radians((j - 1.5) * 4)

# Toy printing press on the opposite end.
press = empty("Friendly little printing press", (6.92, -0.85, 0.75))
box("Press foot", (0, 0, 0.16), (1.18, 1.17, 0.30), M["sky"], 0.13, press)
box("Press cabinet", (0, 0.10, 0.53), (0.93, 0.79, 0.54), PASTEL["sky"], 0.12, press)
for x in (-0.44, 0.44):
    box("Press roller support", (x, 0, 0.99), (0.16, 0.53, 0.72),
        M["tomato"], 0.07, press)
for z in (0.90, 1.19):
    rod("Big rounded print roller", (-0.44, -0.13, z), (0.44, -0.13, z),
        0.14, M["ink"] if z < 1 else M["wood"], press)
box("Paper feed tray", (0, -0.49, 0.78), (0.79, 0.83, 0.09),
    M["wood"], 0.04, press)
box("Fresh sheet from press", (0, -0.61, 0.85), (0.64, 0.67, 0.045),
    M["paper"], 0.02, press)
sphere("Press control button", (0.49, -0.18, 0.59), 0.085, M["sun"], press, True)

# Back-edge paper theatre decorations.
def cloud(x, y, z, size):
    rod("Thin cloud stick", (x, y, 0.76), (x, y, z), 0.025, M["wood"])
    parts = []
    for dx, dz, radius in [(-0.43, -0.02, 0.29), (-0.12, 0.13, 0.38),
                            (0.22, 0.06, 0.34), (0.48, -0.05, 0.24)]:
        parts.append(sphere("Cloud paper lobe",
                            (x + dx * size, y, z + dz * size),
                            (radius * size, 0.10, radius * size * 0.78),
                            M["paper"]))
    join_objects(parts, "Soft scalloped paper cloud")


cloud(-3.65, 4.13, 3.00, 1.05)
cloud(4.75, 4.13, 3.15, 0.90)
rod("Thin sun stick", (0.4, 4.20, 0.75), (0.4, 4.20, 3.26), 0.027, M["wood"])
sun_disc = cylinder("Small paper theatre sun", (0.4, 4.20, 3.40),
                    0.47, 0.12, M["sun"], vertices=48)
sun_disc.rotation_euler.x = math.radians(90)
```

```python
def finish(obj, name, mat, parent=None):
    obj.name = name
    if mat:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    if parent:
        obj.parent = parent
    return obj


def smooth(obj):
    for polygon in obj.data.polygons:
        polygon.use_smooth = True


def box(name, loc, dims, mat, bevel=0.09, parent=None, rotation=None):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=loc)
    obj = bpy.context.object
    obj.dimensions = dims
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    finish(obj, name, mat, parent)
    mod = obj.modifiers.new("Soft handmade corners", 'BEVEL')
    mod.width = min(bevel, min(dims) * 0.47)
    mod.segments = 4
    mod = obj.modifiers.new("Weighted paper normals", 'WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    mod.keep_sharp = True
    if rotation:
        obj.rotation_euler = rotation
    return obj


def sphere(name, loc, scale, mat, parent=None, small=False):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(
        segments=12 if small else 20,
        ring_count=8 if small else 12,
        radius=1, location=loc)
    obj = bpy.context.object
    obj.scale = (scale, scale, scale) if isinstance(scale, (float, int)) else scale
    finish(obj, name, mat, parent)
    smooth(obj)
    return obj


def cylinder(name, loc, radius, depth, mat, parent=None, vertices=24):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(
        vertices=vertices, radius=radius, depth=depth, location=loc)
    obj = bpy.context.object
    finish(obj, name, mat, parent)
    bevel = obj.modifiers.new("Rounded cylinder rims", 'BEVEL')
    bevel.width = min(0.055, depth * 0.22, radius * 0.25)
    bevel.segments = 3
    smooth(obj)
    obj.modifiers.new("Soft normals", 'WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return obj


def rod(name, a, b, radius, mat, parent=None):
    a, b = Vector(a), Vector(b)
    obj = cylinder(name, (a + b) * 0.5, radius, (b - a).length,
                   mat, parent, vertices=16)
    obj.rotation_euler = (b - a).to_track_quat('Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    return obj


def empty(name, loc=(0, 0, 0), parent=None):
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, None)
    scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.location = loc
    obj.parent = parent
    return obj


def join_objects(objects, name):
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
    for obj in objects:
        obj.select_set(True)
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = objects[0]
    bpy.ops.object.join()
    obj = bpy.context.object
    obj.name = name
    return obj
```

```python
def bezier(t, a, b, c, d):
    return (
        (1 - t) ** 3 * Vector(a) +
        3 * (1 - t) ** 2 * t * Vector(b) +
        3 * (1 - t) * t * t * Vector(c) +
        t ** 3 * Vector(d)
    )


def animate_mote(obj, p, phase, amplitude=1.0):
    p = Vector(p)
    for frame in (1, 24, 48):
        a = phase + frame * 0.09
        obj.location = p + amplitude * Vector((
            0.06 * math.sin(a),
            0.06 * math.cos(a),
            0.10 * math.sin(a + 1)))
        obj.keyframe_insert(data_path="location", frame=frame)
```
